title: useUndoHistory — Full Undo/Redo with History Stack
description:
Implement `useUndoHistory` — a hook with a full undo/redo stack. Calling `set` pushes the new value onto a past stack and clears the future stack. `undo` pops from past and pushes current to future. `redo` pops from future and pushes current to past.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { value, set, undo, redo, canUndo, canRedo, history } = useUndoHistory(0);

set(1); // value=1, past=[0]
set(2); // value=2, past=[0,1]
undo();  // value=1, past=[0], future=[2]
redo();  // value=2, past=[0,1], future=[]
console.log(canUndo); // true
```
ai_context: Common mistake: storing past, present, and future as three separate useState calls — this leads to inconsistent intermediate states between renders when multiple state updates happen. Undo/redo requires atomic updates; all three values must be in a single state object updated in one setState call.
